Emma —

Appreciate the clear ask. Quick answers:
- Our most recent SOC 2 Type II testing window is 2027-01-01 through 2027-12-31 (Type II issued May 2028).
- We can provide a bridge letter for gaps relative to your fiscal year; our compliance team issues a short attestation.
- We are generally happy to countersign partner NDAs provided they are mutual and reasonable. Legal prefers to review your standard one quickly.

Plan I propose:
1) Please send the countersigned NDA to legal@redwood.com (or upload to the DocuSign link if you prefer).
2) Once countersigned, we will grant time-limited access to a redacted PDF of the full Type II and the bridge letter if needed.
3) If you need more privileged artifacts (control evidence), we will coordinate an on-demand gated share and an ingress/egress window.

Looping in Lauren (legal) and Monica (compliance) to handle the NDA review and to prepare the redacted excerpt.

—Michael
